description: AME 2020 atomic binding energies for the canonical light isotopes (D, T, 3He, 4He) — comparison-only validation values, NOT prediction inputs. Used by binding-energy-prediction scripts to compute `err = pred - AME_B_<X>_MEV`. Per CLAUDE.md three-calibration discipline (CAL-1 m_e, CAL-2 m_µ/m_e, CAL-3 Q_β), these values are PREDICTIONS of the framework; importing them as upstream inputs to a mass / binding pipeline would inflate the calibration count beyond the allowed 3.

parameters.source: AME 2020 (Wang, M. et al., 'The AME 2020 atomic mass evaluation', Chinese Physics C 45.3 (2021) 030003)
parameters.precision_note: Values truncated to 6-7 sig figs; full AME precision available at https://www-nds.iaea.org/amdc/.
